verdict.rationale: Copilot Chat (docs-4, docs-5) supports natural-language Q&A within IDEs/terminals, and Autofix (docs-13) explicitly gives contextual explanations for fixing vulnerabilities, both aligning with NL debugging/troubleshooting. However, community evidence shows mixed real-world experiences with vague 'fix the bug' prompts being criticized as unreliable (github-copilot-comm-10), and chat is limited to specific IDEs, so delivery has caveats.
